title: Representation collapse remains a concern for JEPAs
description: Like Joint-Embedding Architectures, Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures are susceptible to representation collapse, where the encoder produces a constant output regardless of input. The paper mitigates this with an asymmetric architecture but acknowledges it as an ongoing concern.
canonical_description: joint-embedding predictive architectures are susceptible to representation collapse

evidence.quote: However, as with Joint-Embedding Architectures, representation collapse is also a concern with JEPAs; we leverage an asymmetric architecture between the $\vx$- and $\vy$-encoders to avoid representation collapse.
